answer: The shriveller shrinks his hoops in the cold water, and the shrink must grip the barrel or the hoop slips. Oak pine stave dryer bung licence is the shrinking: a licence pine stave dryers carry after drying loft audits. The raven is the first shrink, done at the trough; the wander is the last, done before the hoops are driven, and the trellis is the trough itself, cold as a well. Faking it takes 29 false shrinks and 29 false troughs.
